company.name: DimOrder
company.shortDescription: DimOrder is a restaurant fintech platform enabling digital payments and data-driven supply chain financing for F&B merchants in Asia.
company.description:
DimOrder is building the financial operating infrastructure for restaurants in Asia, combining POS, ordering, payments, merchant data and embedded finance into one platform.

DimOrder helps restaurants digitize their daily operations through QR ordering, POS, payment acceptance, settlement records, membership, reporting and transaction analytics. By capturing real-time operating and payment data from F&B merchants, DimOrder creates a trusted data layer that can support faster, more efficient access to supply chain financing and working capital solutions.

The company’s long-term vision is to become a data-driven fintech infrastructure provider for the restaurant industry, helping merchants improve payment efficiency, transaction visibility, cash flow management and financing accessibility. DimOrder operates across Hong Kong and Southeast Asia, with a focus on serving restaurateurs.
company.headquarters: Yau Tsim Mong, Kowloon, Hong Kong
